title: Playlist tuple return types instead of struct
description: audio_db functions get_audio_playlist, list_audio_playlists, and list_user_audio_playlists return raw tuples ((i64, i64, String, String, String, i64), etc.) rather than a PlaylistRow struct. This forces callers to destructure with positional indices (pl.0, pl.2, pl.5), which is fragile and unreadable -- visible in the handler code where playlist tuple fields are mapped with (id, user_id, title, desc, vis, created_at). Every other entity in the DB layer (TrackRow, AudioChannelRow, BookRow, ReviewRow, etc.) uses a named struct. Fix: add a PlaylistRow struct and use it consistently.
